The previous tenant left the property around 2008 and failed to close the leasehold title. A copy of the leasehold title is included within the legal pack. Correspondence has been sent to the Insolvency Service to request that the bankruptcy notice and bankruptcy restriction be removed in order to close the leasehold title. The current tenant has been in occupation of the property since 24th August 2016.The Insolvency Service confirmed on 4th July 2019 that they have made an application to HM Land Registry to remove the bankruptcy notices/entries which are preventing the leasehold title of CH521481 (relating to a lease dated 21st May 2004) from being closed. HM Land Registry have been made aware that the Insolvency Service have made a request for the bankruptcy notices/entries to be removed. The Seller's solicitor await a response. In respect of No.75 Witton Street, the tenant E Cig (Cheadle) Limited is being granted a new five year renewal lease from 13th December 2020, subject to contract. The lease will be on the same terms as the existing lease which is included within the legal pack at a rent of £13,000 p.a. It will be a renewal lease with reference to the existing lease. The tenant has agreed to pay the Landlord’s legal fees of £650.00 plus VAT. It is currently in solicitors hands. The tenant has paid the Landlord’s legal fees to the Landlord’s solicitor on Friday 5th July 2019. A draft version of the renewal lease has been sent to the tenant for approval on 8th July 2019. A copy of the draft lease is included within the legal pack. HM Land Registry have now completed the application to close the leasehold title which related to an old lease dated 21st May 2004, where the previous tenant had vacated the premises in 2008 and did not close the leasehold title, for 77 Witton Street and that was noted on the freehold title register for 75 and 77 Witton Street. The renewal lease for 75 Witton Street has been approved, today, by the Tenant’s (The E-Cig Store (Cheadle) Limited) solicitor who confirmed that they will arrange for signature by their client. The renewal lease has also been sent to the seller for execution in readiness for completion.
